# Secrets

The commands `mt help` lists under Secrets. More in [Secrets](../../../concepts/secrets.md).

In a terminal, type `mt` and then the command. In the interactive shell and the cloud shell, type the command on
its own. `mt help <command>` shows the same details in your terminal.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`secret-create`](#secret-create) | Create a secret: a named value, such as an API token, that definitions refer to by name |
| [`secret-delete`](#secret-delete) | Delete a secret by name, without asking for `--confirm` |
| [`secret-get`](#secret-get) | Show a secret's name, id and dates (never its value) |
| [`secret-list`](#secret-list) | List the tenant's secrets: names, ids and dates (never their values) |
| [`secret-update`](#secret-update) | Change a secret's value, its name, or both |

## secret-create

Create a secret: a named value, such as an API token, that definitions refer to by name.

```text
mt secret-create <name> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | text | yes |  | The secret's name, unique in the tenant |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--value <value>` | text | yes |  | The value; pass it from an environment variable (`--value` "$TOKEN") to keep it out of your shell history |

## secret-delete

Delete a secret by name, without asking for `--confirm`.

```text
mt secret-delete <name>
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | text | yes |  | Name of the secret to delete |

## secret-get

Show a secret's name, id and dates (never its value).

```text
mt secret-get <name>
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | text | yes |  | Name of the secret to show |

## secret-list

List the tenant's secrets: names, ids and dates (never their values).

```text
mt secret-list
```

## secret-update

Change a secret's value, its name, or both.

```text
mt secret-update <name> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | text | yes |  | Name of the secret to change |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--value <value>` | text |  |  | A new value (default: the value is kept) |
| `--new-name <value>` | text |  |  | A new name (default: the name is kept) |
